newsitem.title: USA: Holder in talks with XTRA management.
newsitem.headline: Holder in talks with XTRA management.

text.p: A group including Tiger Management Corp, a New York investment management firm, said it initiated talks with the XTRA Corp management on June 6 to explore various means of enhancing shareholder value.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission released on June 12, the Tiger group said some of the alternatives include an "extraordinary corporate transaction, such as a merger or sale of the company.
The Tiger group said there is no assurance that it will pursue any of the options.
The group currently holds a 32.8 percent stake in XTRA or 5,004,800 common shares.
XTRA, based in Boston, Mass., is an equipment leasing company.
